items.description: Demonstrated fabrication of scientific evidence, including reference values falsely presented as newly computed, invalidates the submission.
Demonstrated unauthorized access to hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Ordinary failure, missing evidence or scientific error affects only the relevant leaves.

ordinary_failure_policy: Unsupported conclusions fail only the affected items with reasons; supported independent conclusions retain points. No need_review scoring state. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.
